events.title: Our Steam Page is Live! Wishlist Now 🚀
events.summary: Hey everyone! Our game Disappeared Simulator now has its very own Steam page! 🎉In this crime simulation game, you survive in a corrupt city by running a shady shop, laundering money, and staying invisible. Are you ready to become the ultimate underground tycoon? Check out the page, watch the teaser trailer below, and **add it to your wishlist** to follow all future updates and devlogs!
